description: Keeps knives organized and within reach. Saves counter space.

name: Teak Wood Chopping Board
shortDescription: Premium solid teak wood chopping board for daily kitchen use.
description: Crafted from highly durable teak wood, this chopping board is gentle on your knives. It is naturally resistant to moisture and bacteria.
careInstructions: Hand wash only. Apply food-grade mineral oil monthly.

name: Wooden Spices Holder
description: Keeps Spices organized and within reach. Saves counter space.

name: Wooden Kitchen Set
shortDescription: Premium wooden kitchen set with essential cooking tools.
description: A durable wooden kitchen set that includes a chopping board, wooden spoon, and spatula. Designed for everyday cooking, it is safe for non-stick cookware, easy to clean, and adds a natural touch to your kitchen.
careInstructions: Hand wash with mild soap and water. Wipe dry immediately. Do not soak in water or place in the dishwasher.

name: Wooden Chakla Belan Set
shortDescription: Premium wooden chakla belan set for smooth and easy rolling.
description: A durable wooden chakla belan set designed for making rotis, chapatis, parathas, and other flatbreads. The set includes a sturdy wooden rolling board (chakla) and a comfortable rolling pin (belan), providing a smooth rolling experience for everyday cooking.
careInstructions: Clean with a damp cloth and wipe dry immediately. Do not soak in water or place in the dishwasher.

name: Wooden Bowl
shortDescription: Elegant handcrafted wooden bowl for serving and dining.
description: A premium wooden bowl crafted from natural wood, perfect for serving salads, fruits, snacks, dry fruits, or desserts. Its smooth finish and durable construction make it ideal for both everyday use and special occasions.
features: Perfect for Serving Snacks, Fruits, and Salads
careInstructions: Hand wash with mild soap and wipe dry immediately. Do not soak in water or place in the dishwasher.
